newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market brisk at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market brisk at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active after a slow start on Tuesday, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 15,900 slaughter steers and 11,200 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 42,600 head confirmed including 3,700 head or about 9 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1040-1350 lbs, mostly 1175- 1225 lbs 71.00; Select with end Choice including cutting bulls 1150-1400 lbs 70.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 115.00, some including cutting bulls 113.00-113.50 hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1200 lbs, mostly 1050- 1100 lbs 71.00, few early 70.00; few mixed
Commercial to Choice 1175 lb heifers and heiferettes 70.00; pen 1075-1190 lb heifers, heiferettes and cows 67.50-68.50.
Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 113.50.
Confirmed - 27,100 last week - none last year - 33,300
Wk to date - 42,600 last week - 3,300 last year - 37,000
